h_both_edge.instruction: Both hands. Push one hand to the very edge of the picture so half of it is cut off by the edge. The other hand stays in the middle.
h_both_edge.subject: subject1

h_R_no_arm.instruction: Right hand only. Hold your hand very low, so that only the fingers and palm show at the bottom of the picture and your whole forearm is below the picture.
h_R_no_arm.subject: subject1

h_both_one_no_arm.instruction: Both hands. One hand raised normally with its arm visible. The other hand held very low, only fingers and palm showing at the bottom of the picture, forearm below the picture.
h_both_one_no_arm.subject: subject1
